I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I confirmed that no action is needed on the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply and that the deadline is 6 June. I didn't take any other action.

I also asked him which year he means. Today is 14 Oct 2026 on the simulation clock, so 6 June 2026 has already passed, and I asked whether he meant 6 June 2027.

I couldn't find anything about Halyard to confirm the date. I checked the knowledge brain, the #central-team history and the public files, which Hollis can see too. The only record is his own message.
